clue.text: Reserve first to block ball

indicators.note: a piece that blocks another sits in the middle of it, so these words put one piece inside the other

parts.note: a ball is a formal dance
first is written 1ST, with the figure one read as the letter I

explanation.surface: A cricket or football instruction: keep a substitute back to stop the ball.
explanation.walkthrough: The figure 1 in 1ST is read as the letter I. 'Ball' looks like sport, but it is a formal dance.
explanation.definitionFit: Reserve in the sense of aloofness or coolness of manner is a synonym of emotional remoteness.

clue.text: Red pipe down one level with end sawn off

parts.note: an order to pipe down, to be quiet, is the interjection sh
one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: cutting off the end of a word removes its final letter

parts.note: to level a building is to raze it

explanation.surface: Instructions for lowering a red pipe and sawing off its end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with end sawn off' drops the last E of RAZE to leave RAZ.
explanation.definitionFit: Shiraz is a grape variety that makes a well-known red wine, so the noun stands for a red.

clue.text: The usual meal in a train upset diet expert

parts.note: par is the normal or usual standard

indicators.note: upset letters are tipped over and rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A nutritionist is upset by the usual food served on a train.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' rearranges MEALINATRAIN into LIAMENTARIAN. A diet is also a legislative assembly, as in the Japanese Diet, so the diet expert is not a nutritionist.
explanation.definitionFit: A diet is a national assembly, and someone expert in the workings of such an assembly is a seasoned legislator.

clue.text: Passed on pound to open shelter? Most generous!

indicators.note: a piece that opens another goes into its middle, splitting it

parts.note: a nest is a shelter or snug retreat
ob, short for Latin obiit, means died or passed on
L, from Latin libra, is the abbreviation for a pound

explanation.surface: Praise for someone who, having died, left money to fund a shelter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to open' puts OBL (OB, then L) inside NEST. OB is the abbreviation for obiit, seen on gravestones; 'on' just links the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Noble can mean magnanimous or high-minded, so its superlative describes the most generous of spirit.

clue.text: Capital is one built strangely without university

indicators.note: something built strangely is put together in an odd arrangement, signalling a rearrangement

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: without means lacking, so a letter is removed

explanation.surface: A remark that some capital city was oddly built and has no university.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' takes U out of BUILT to give BILT; 'strangely' rearranges IS, I and BILT.
explanation.definitionFit: Tbilisi is the capital city of Georgia, an example of a capital.

clue.text: Secure and abundant source for weapon

parts.note: to land something, like a deal or a fish, is to secure it
a mine of information is a rich, abundant source

explanation.surface: Advice to obtain a plentiful supply of arms.
explanation.definitionFit: A buried explosive set off by pressure is a type of weapon.

clue.text: Great pessimism about accommodating divisions

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the letters are read backwards
the two words accommodate, or hold within them, the letters wanted

explanation.surface: Deep gloom over housing that has split people apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accommodating' finds ATPES within greAT PESsimism; 'about' turns it round. Septa are dividing walls, as in the nose or heart.
explanation.definitionFit: Septa are partitions in anatomy, so the plural noun means walls or divisions between cavities.

clue.text: Experienced hands in opposition in shadowy world

parts.note: to have had something is to have experienced it
in bridge the four hands are North, South, East and West; East and South are on opposing sides

explanation.surface: Veteran workers facing off in a murky place.
explanation.walkthrough: Bridge players are named by compass point, partners sitting opposite, so E and S are opponents.
explanation.definitionFit: Hades is the underworld of Greek myth, the realm of shades, a gloomy place of the dead.

clue.text: Offensive, one leaving record company with little money

indicators.note: one piece leaving another is taken out of it

parts.note: an indie is a small independent record label
one is the Roman numeral I
a cent is a small coin, a tiny amount of money

explanation.surface: A rude person walking out of a record label with very little cash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaving' removes one I from INDIE to leave INDE.
explanation.definitionFit: Indecent behaviour or language is shocking and objectionable, so offensive is a near synonym.

clue.text: Hollywood actor in drag forgetting line after dull finish

indicators.note: after signals that the piece it governs comes behind the other in the answer

parts.note: matt describes a dull, non-glossy finish on paint or photographs

indicators.note: forgetting a letter means leaving it out

parts.note: to drag something is to haul it

explanation.surface: A film star appearing in women's clothing who forgets a line after a lacklustre ending.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drag' suggests cross-dressing, but it means pull. Walter Matthau starred in The Odd Couple.
explanation.definitionFit: Walter Matthau was a Hollywood film actor famous for comic roles such as The Odd Couple.

clue.text: Flog comb for one's back

parts.note: to comb an area is to search it thoroughly, to scour it

indicators.note: back means turned the other way, so these letters are read in reverse

parts.note: for one introduces an example, as eg does

explanation.surface: Use a comb as a whip on someone's back.
explanation.definitionFit: To scourge is to whip someone, so it means to flog as a punishment.

clue.text: Office manager putting emphasis on fee following note

parts.note: a sub is a subscription, a regular fee
post means after or following, as in postwar
mi is the third note of the sol-fa scale
stress means emphasis

explanation.surface: A manager insists on charges after receiving a memo.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a sub-post office is a small branch post office, often inside a shop, run by a woman who holds this title.
explanation.definitionFit: She runs a sub-post office, a small branch post office, so she is a manager of an office.

clue.text: Drops of inferior alcohol?

definitions.meaning: puts something down heavily, as one sets down a heavy bag
cheap, poor-quality wines, as in a bottle of cheap red

explanation.definitionFit: To plonk is to set down heavily, and plonk is British slang for cheap wine.

clue.text: Friend displays heart, carrying maiden home

indicators.note: one piece carrying another holds it inside

parts.note: the core of something is its heart
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over
a pad is slang for one's home or flat

explanation.surface: A friend shows his feelings by carrying a young woman home.
explanation.walkthrough: A maiden is a cricket over in which no runs are scored.
explanation.definitionFit: Compadre is Spanish-derived informal American usage for a companion or close friend.

clue.text: Female lawyer call centre's abandoned

parts.note: a DA is a district attorney, an American prosecuting lawyer

indicators.note: the central letter of the word is dropped, as if abandoned

parts.note: to phone someone is to call them

explanation.surface: A woman attorney walks out of a call centre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Call centre' looks like one phrase but splits: the centre of the call word is the letter dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: Daphne is a woman's given name, so it can stand for a female in crosswords.

clue.text: Area with stunted growth that is also holding foreign currency, briefly

indicators.note: the outer pieces holding another enclose it between them

parts.note: sc, short for Latin scilicet, means that is to say
and means also or in addition

indicators.note: briefly means shortened, so the last letter is cut

parts.note: the ruble, or rouble, is the currency of Russia

explanation.surface: A patch of scrub also holding some foreign cash.
explanation.walkthrough: SC stands for Latin scilicet; 'briefly' trims the last letter of the currency.
explanation.definitionFit: Scrubland is land covered in scrub, low stunted trees and bushes.

clue.text: Flavour of article accompanying incorrect witness statement?

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
a witness saying I seed, ungrammatical dialect for I saw

explanation.surface: An article quoting a witness whose statement was inaccurate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Incorrect' points to the bad grammar of I SEED, not a false testimony.
explanation.definitionFit: The seed of the anise plant gives a liquorice taste, so it is a flavouring.

clue.text: High-speed traveller caught on roundabout by police

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
a roundabout is round in shape, like the letter O
the Met is London's Metropolitan Police

explanation.surface: A speeding driver caught at a roundabout by the police.
explanation.walkthrough: A roundabout is a road junction circling a central island, and its circular shape gives O.
explanation.definitionFit: A comet hurtles through space at great speed, a celestial body that travels fast.

clue.text: Chap's going without a struggle — if approached by them?

definitions.text: Chap's going without a struggle — if approached by them?

indicators.note: going without means going outside, so one piece wraps round the other

parts.note: a chap is a he, so chap's (chap is) gives he's
to vie is to contend or struggle

explanation.surface: A man gives up meekly when big thugs come up to him.
explanation.walkthrough: Read whole, the clue says a man yields without a fight when such men approach.
explanation.definitionFit: Heavies are hired thugs or strong-arm men, the sort who make a man surrender meekly.

clue.text: Healing technique involving touching kicks in regularly

parts.note: re means concerning or touching on

indicators.note: taking letters regularly means every other one

explanation.surface: A therapy involving touch suddenly takes effect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes the even letters of kIcKs In to give IKI. 'Touching' wants to be part of the definition, but it is RE.
explanation.definitionFit: Reiki is a Japanese healing practice in which the therapist channels energy through the hands.

clue.text: Managed a variable packing business informally from South Island

indicators.note: in a down answer, reading from the south means reading upwards, in reverse
one piece packing another holds it inside

parts.note: to run something is to manage it
biz is informal slang for business
z is an algebraic variable

explanation.surface: Running a small business shipped from the south of an island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'packing' gives RABIZN; add A and Z to give RABIZNAZ, which 'from South' reads upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Zanzibar is an island off the east coast of Africa, part of Tanzania.

clue.text: Plant big punch — rough stuff around noon

indicators.note: around means surrounding, so one piece is put round another

parts.note: a KO is a knockout, a decisive punch
tweed is a rough woollen cloth

explanation.surface: A violent scene of punching and rough play around midday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rough stuff' looks like violence, but it is cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Japanese knotweed is an invasive plant, so knotweed names a type of plant.

clue.text: Resignation announcement after Home Secretary's latest misdeed

indicators.note: after signals that the piece it governs follows the other

parts.note: in means at home
someone resigning announces I quit

indicators.note: the latest letter of a word is its last

explanation.surface: A Home Secretary resigns over a wrongdoing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'latest' takes Y, the last letter of Secretary's. 'Home Secretary' looks like the British cabinet post, but splits into IN and a source of Y.
explanation.definitionFit: An iniquity is a wicked act or great injustice, so it means a misdeed.

clue.text: Correspondent's twenty-four hours in confined place to conclude

indicators.note: a piece placed in others is put between or inside them

parts.note: a pen is an enclosure for animals
to end something is to conclude it
Friday, abbreviated Fri, is one day of twenty-four hours

explanation.surface: A letter writer spends a day locked up before bringing things to an end.
explanation.definitionFit: A pen friend is someone you exchange letters with, so a correspondent.

clue.text: So cheerful about doctor's encouraging signal

indicators.note: about means around, so the outer pieces go round the inner one

parts.note: thus means so or therefore
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification
up means in good spirits, cheerful

explanation.surface: A doctor's cheerful encouragement.
explanation.definitionFit: A raised thumb is a gesture of approval or encouragement.

clue.text: School superior to Yale? Rubbish!

indicators.note: in a down answer, superior means placed above, so first

parts.note: a Yale is a brand of lock

explanation.surface: A question whether a school beats Yale University, dismissed as nonsense.
explanation.walkthrough: Yale suggests the American university, but it is a brand of door lock.
explanation.definitionFit: Schlock is informal for cheap, shoddy goods, so trash or rubbish.

clue.text: Yield to pressure, revealing garment

parts.note: a crop is the yield of a harvest

explanation.surface: Giving in to pressure and exposing a piece of clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A crop top is a short top that exposes the midriff, a revealing item of clothing.

clue.text: Thought bird should be put on spot

indicators.note: in a down answer, one piece put on another sits above it

parts.note: a pen is a female swan
to spot something is to see it

explanation.surface: Someone thinks a bird belongs on a particular place.
explanation.definitionFit: A pensée is a French word for a thought or reflection, written down as a maxim.

clue.text: Bill loves something he can't have?

parts.note: a tab is a bill, as in picking up the tab
love is zero in tennis, and two zeros look like the letters OO

explanation.surface: Bill adores something forbidden to him.
explanation.walkthrough: Bill reads as a man's name, but it is the bill for drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: A taboo is something prohibited by custom, so a thing one is not allowed.

clue.text: Employing craft, it's said, leave Irish port

indicators.note: it's said signals that the word is heard rather than written

parts.note: craft is cunning, so someone using it is sly
to go is to leave

explanation.surface: Using a boat, people depart from an Irish harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: Craft suggests a boat, but here it is guile. The port is pronounced like 'sly go'.
explanation.definitionFit: Sligo is a seaport town in the north-west of Ireland.
